RECOMMENDATIONS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. IMMEDIATE ACTION REQUIRED:
   - Review each account listed above
   - Identify the account owner/administrator
   - Assign at least one Super User role to an active user

2. PREVENTIVE MEASURES:
   - Implement automated alerts when last Super User is removed
   - Require Super User approval for account registration
   - Conduct quarterly audits of Super User assignments

   - Establish minimum Super User count per account (recommend: 2-3)
   - Document Super User responsibilities and rotation policies
   - Create escalation procedures for accounts without Super Users
